subject.title: feat(gateway): wire read coding tool into HTTP /tools/invoke (narrow)

question: Should owner/admin Gateway callers be allowed to expose the built-in host-filesystem `read` tool over HTTP and SDK direct invocation through this explicit opt-in, including paths outside the workspace when `tools.fs.workspaceOnly` is not enabled?
rationale: The code can enforce the proposed gates, but only repository owners can decide whether authenticated direct host-file disclosure is an intended product and security boundary.

options.title: Accept triple-gated host read
options.body: Approve the current explicit allow, direct-invoke opt-in, owner identity gate, audit warning, and separately configurable workspace confinement.

options.title: Require workspace confinement
options.body: Allow the capability only when direct-invoke reads are always restricted to the configured workspace.

options.title: Reject built-in host read
options.body: Keep direct invocation limited to existing core and plugin tools without materializing the built-in coding reader.

recommendation.title: Accept triple-gated host read
recommendation.body: Approve the current explicit allow, direct-invoke opt-in, owner identity gate, audit warning, and separately configurable workspace confinement.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev merged the shared direct-invoke RPC and dispatcher path that defines this capability boundary, with steipete and the security CODEOWNERS area as additional review context.
